request: Show the total lines added and removed on an edit's line in the chat, and on a group of edits. In src/lib/toolGroups.ts export editCounts(argsList) taking the args of write calls ({path, old_text?, content}) and returning {added, removed} summed over the edits (calls with old_text: lines of content added, lines of old_text removed, by a line diff), or undefined when no call counts. Whole-file writes (no old_text) and edits to the agent's context (path "@context" or under "@context/") don't count. Show the counts green/red in ToolCallGroup.tsx.
